expectedPublicationDelay.delayDescription: Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of at least 1 day(s) between the publication date and published data.

temporalVariables.columnDescription: Temporal information of the value specified in the property 'valueCategory'.
temporalVariables.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of temporal value in the property 'temporal'. The 'temporal_type' before 2024-05-18 (2024-W20) refers to the sentinella week definition (week start Saturday, end Friday). From 2024-05-27 (2024-W22) onwards ISO week (week start Monday, end Sunday) is used. To enable the switch from sentinella week to ISO week, a 'long sentinella week' was inserted from 2024-05-18 to 2024-05-26 (2024-W21).

georegion.columnDescription: Geographical unit of the data record.
georegion.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of geographical unit in the property 'georegion'.

subtype.columnDescription: Subtype specification used for grouping within the property 'type'.

testResult.typeColumnDescription: Specifies from which type of test the property 'testResult' was derived. Abbreviation: pcr = polymerase chain reaction test.

type.columnDescription: Type specification used for grouping. Distinguishes between different influenza types (denoted in 'pathogen'), i.e., 'A' and 'B'.

value.description: Represents the value defined by the property 'valueCategory' within the given temporal unit and grouping.

prctPathogen.description: Percentage within the given temporal unit and grouping described in the property name. Based on the property 'value'.

lowerCiPathogen.description: Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval of the property 'prctPathogen'. The confidence intervals for respiratory pathogens in sentinella are estimated using the Wilson method for binomial confidence intervals.

upperCiPathogen.description: Upper bound of the 95% confidence interval of the property 'prctPathogen'. The confidence intervals for respiratory pathogens in sentinella are estimated using the Wilson method for binomial confidence intervals.

prctPathogenMean3w.description: Center-aligned, rolling 3-week average of the property 'prctPathogen' within the grouping described in the property name.

prctSamples.description: Percentage within the given temporal unit and grouping described in the property name. Based on the property 'value'.

prctPathogenType.description: Percentage within the given temporal unit and grouping described in the property name. Based on the property 'value'.

prctPathogenSubtype.description: Percentage within the given temporal unit and grouping described in the property name. Based on the property 'value'.

prctTypeSubtype.description: Percentage within the given temporal unit and grouping described in the property name. Based on the property 'value'.

dataComplete.description: Can data be assumed to be complete (few late reportings to be expected)?

defaultView.description: Indicates if an entry will be displayed on the dashboard as default or not.
